Something at the end of the street just called your name. In your voice.
Last time, a flashlight blinked back at you from across the street.

text: You step outside. The flashlight clicks off.

A girl in a yellow raincoat walks out of the dark. Mia.
She holds up her phone. Texts from her own number. Just like yours.
Everyone else is frozen. It's just the two of you.
Then the air at the end of the street crackles like a broken TV. A tall shadow steps out.
It calls your name in your voice. Mia whispers, don't answer it.
Your battery drops to three percent.

text: Then the shadow speaks again. It says Mia. In Mia's voice.
Would you run or hide? Comment one word.
